transitionMatrix.name: run-local eligible -> retry / at-target / terminal and pass -> continue / stop
transitionMatrix.source: Durable before/after board, linked PR and cycle state plus invocation-local best/results; real handler state readers exercised
transitionMatrix.acceptedEvent: A completed card invocation for its ordered id; only state strictly later than its prior best buys another pass
transitionMatrix.predecessor: Before-run durable snapshot/high-water state; prior pass must contain actual progress
transitionMatrix.next: Only unfinished nonterminal cards remain pending in original order; completed cards omitted; otherwise no-progress/pass-cap
transitionMatrix.persistentEffects: Existing audit line only; no new workflow ledger or event schema
transitionMatrix.immutableFields: Input card order and card identity; sealed r1-g1 tests untouched; best never decreases during invocation
transitionMatrix.forbidden: Engine text, new commit alone, unrelated PR, unreadable state and recovered prior maximum cannot buy a pass; prepare success alone cannot declare completion
transitionMatrix.replayRetryRestart: C1/C7 prevent replay progress; I2/I3 prevent oscillation; I1 re-reads durable completion on a new invocation
transitionMatrix.terminalPreconditions: Durably completed/Done or existing explicit target; human/terminal statuses override prepared; cap and no-progress leave unfinished cards unfinished
transitionMatrix.metrics: Pass count increments once per pass; exit0 only all-at-target, otherwise exit1; W4 checks audit order/outcomes
transitionMatrix.negativeFamilies: Applicable run-local families have rows; persisted ledger/head/scope/seal families are excluded with N1 rationale
